explanation: Wild relatives still grow in north-east Africa, and ancient Egyptians placed watermelon seeds in tombs, Tutankhamun's among them.

claims.text: Watermelons were first domesticated in Africa.
Watermelons were not first domesticated in Asia, South America or Europe.
Wild relatives of the watermelon grow in north-east Africa.
Watermelon seeds were found in ancient Egyptian tombs, including Tutankhamun's.
